name: What is the typical timeline for designing and building an ADU?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for designing and building an ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical timeline for an ADU project, from initial design to final construction, generally ranges from 8 to 18 months. This includes several phases: conceptual design (1-2 months), architectural and engineering plans (2-4 months), permitting review and approval (2-6 months, highly variable), and actual construction (3-6 months). Factors like design complexity, site conditions, and city permitting office workload can significantly influence the overall duration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Designing and building an ADU typically takes 8 to 18 months, encompassing design, planning, permitting, and construction phases. Permitting time is highly variable.
